name: The Galleria at Presidents Place
summary: The Galleria at Presidents Place is a 350,119 SF mixed-use development in Quincy's urban core, featuring life science, office, retail, medical office, and institutional space. Located steps from the Quincy Center Red Line station, the property has recently undergone lab infrastructure upgrades and serves as a dynamic hub for commerce, healthcare, and innovation.
demographics: The Galleria at Presidents Place attracts a diverse urban demographic from Quincy and surrounding Boston metro communities, including young professionals, medical professionals, and life science workers drawn to the mixed-use environment. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with a median age range of 25-54, benefiting from proximity to the Quincy Center Red Line and commuter rail station. Primary visitors include office workers seeking convenient retail and dining options, medical patients and staff from the on-site medical offices, and local residents who value the urban core location and transit accessibility.
description: The Galleria at Presidents Place stands as a cornerstone of Quincy's urban core, offering a dynamic 350,119 square foot mixed-use development that seamlessly integrates life science, office, retail, institutional, and medical office space. Located at 1250 Hancock Street, this innovative center sits steps from the Quincy Center Red Line and commuter rail stop, as well as the new Hancock Adams Green, providing unparalleled transit connectivity for the Greater Boston area. The property has recently undergone significant lab infrastructure upgrades throughout the building, positioning it as a premier destination for cutting-edge life science tenants and medical professionals. As a true mixed-use destination, Presidents Place serves multiple constituencies throughout the day - from office workers and lab researchers to medical patients and retail shoppers - creating a vibrant, active environment in the heart of Quincy. The center's strategic location and diverse tenant mix make it an essential hub for commerce, healthcare, and innovation in the South Shore region.
